'''Henry N. Chapman''' FRS (born 1967) is a British physicist and the founding director of the [https://www.cfel.de/Center Center for Free-Electron Laser Science]{{Dead link|date=November 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} at the [[German Electron Synchrotron]] (DESY).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.deutschland.de/en/topic/knowledge/higher-education-research/leibniz-prize-2015-for-henry-n-chapman |title=Leibniz Prize 2015 for Henry N. == Education and career ==
Henry Chapman earned his Ph.D. from [[Melbourne University]], in [[Australia]]. He then joined [[Stony Brook University]] in the [[United States]], working in the group of Chris Jacobsen on the [[National Synchrotron Light Source]] in the field of [[coherent diffraction imaging]] and [[X-ray crystallography]]. In 1996 he joined [[Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory]] where he worked on [[extreme ultraviolet lithography]]. In 2007, he moved to [[DESY]] to become the Founding Director of CFEL Coherent Imaging Group.<ref>[https://www.desy.de/about_desy/lead_scientists/henry_chapman/index_eng.html Henry Chapman – DESY]</ref>
